In the interior wide shot at 00:19 the man instead enters through a door on the wall perpendicular to that window wall, positioned beside the kitchen pass-through at the kitchen end. The doorway seen to the right of the pass-through in the 00:11-00:19 counter shot is on the opposite side of the pass-through from the 00:19 doorway. The entrance therefore occupies two different walls in different shots, so the established exterior layout cannot explain the interior doorway used for entry/exit (also reused at 01:41).
